description: Get operating hours (open/close times) for a Six Flags park, from today forward. Defaults to your home park. Use this to plan what time to arrive and how long you have.

days.description: How many days ahead to include (default 10)

park.description: Park name, slug, or id. Defaults to your home park (Carowinds).

view.description: "full" (default) returns the structured schedule; "brief" returns one line per entry: park — <YYYY-MM-DD> — <open HH:MM–HH:MM | the entry type>, inside the untrusted-data envelope as `data` (the operator’s own text); an empty window answers the note line `-- none`.

name: sixflags_get_park_schedule
